speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the combination of abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria in a sexually active 17-year-old raises concern for a urinary tract infection, pelvic inflammatory disease, or appendicitis. Has the pain started in your lower right abdomen and moved elsewhere, or does it radiate to your back or shoulder? Also, have you noticed any vaginal discharge or irregular bleeding?
